summary: Tradition swap: blavatsky-sd from western_esoteric to new theosophy tradition (chunk-id rewrite migration)
description:
USER DECISION (2026-08-26): move H.P. Blavatsky's The Secret Doctrine (blavatsky-sd) from tradition western_esoteric into a NEW tradition 'theosophy'. Motivation: a second Theosophy-adjacent text (Steiner's Occult Science, 1909) is planned next; a dedicated tradition gives the lineage proper footing. Blavatsky is the theosophical root; Steiner is the Anthroposophist schism but doctrinally continuous.

SCOPE — what the swap touches:
1. sources/manifest.toml: tradition = "theosophy" (blavatsky-sd [[source]] block)
2. chunking config: move chunking/western_esoteric/blavatsky-sd.toml -> chunking/theosophy/blavatsky-sd.toml
3. corpus dir: move corpus/western_esoteric/blavatsky-sd/ -> corpus/theosophy/blavatsky-sd/
4. DB chunk-id rewrite (the heavy part — chunk ids embed the tradition prefix):
   nodes.id: 727 chunk nodes western_esoteric.blavatsky-sd.* -> theosophy.blavatsky-sd.*
   edges.source_id / edges.target_id: ~5,499 edges (EXPRESSES 4,772 + BELONGS_TO 727)
   chunk_embeddings.chunk_id: 727 rows
   tagging_progress.chunk_id: 727 rows
   staged_summaries.child_chunk_ids: JSON arrays in the 192 accepted L1 rows (+ future L2 rows)
   nodes.metadata_json.text_id stays 'blavatsky-sd' (unchanged — work_id/dossier refs survive)
5. Create the 'theosophy' tradition node (or let graph-bootstrap create it)

DESIGN NOTES:
- Follow the existing migration pattern: scripts/migrations/v3_004_normalize_chunk_ids.sql did a chunk-id rewrite; v3_001..v3_012 show the verify-before/verify-after convention. Write as a script (SQL or py), not freehand.
- Verify counts before/after on every table. The edges table is the largest risk — a missed endpoint orphan silences a whole PARALLEL/EXPRESSES path.
- staged_summaries.child_chunk_ids is JSON text — needs a JSON-aware rewrite (json_each or python), not a naive string replace.
- Tradition id 'theosophy' must be globally unique across the manifest; confirm no existing tradition or text id collides.
- Run only when no generation is writing (dossier stream parked). data/guru.db is git-ignored + shared across branches — check  and  after migration to confirm both state machines still read the work correctly.

TIMING: after the blavatsky-sd dossier stream (D2-D6) completes — do not race running generation. Ticket opened 2026-08-26 with the dossier stream in-flight; scheduled action once D2 generation is done.

Also: when the new 'theosophy' tradition exists, Steiner's Occult Science vetted by explorer should land directly in it from node 01.

resolution.note: Manifest + chunking moved to theosophy. Dry-run-default migration rewrites western_esoteric.blavatsky-sd.* → theosophy.blavatsky-sd.* (JSON-aware). Not applied to live guru.db; gated on dossier-stream park.
